device.description: 8-bit 8-channel 500 kSPS-1 MSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc088s102.pdf (SNAS339B) p.1 connection diagram, p.2-3 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.4-5 electrical characteristics (straight binary, tCONVERT 13 SCLK), p.6 timing specifications and serial timing diagram, p.14-15 serial interface and Tables 1-3 control register, p.15 transfer function

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal control register (Table 1: DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC DONTC DONTC), write-only; first conversion after power-up is IN0 (Table 3 default), p.15

commands.name: Control Register
commands.note: DIN on the first 8 SCLK rising edges after CS falls: ADD2-ADD0 select the input of the NEXT conversion (Table 3: code = INn)

pages: p.1 connection diagram, p.2-3 pin descriptions; p.3 (VA 2.7-5.25 V, VD 2.7 V to VA, digital inputs 0 V to VA); p.4-5 (straight binary, tCONVERT 13 SCLK, throughput 16 SCLK); p.6 (tEN 30, tDACC 27, tDIS 20 ns max; 4 leading zeros, DB7-DB0, 4 trailing zeros, DOUT on SCLK falling, DIN on SCLK rising); p.14-15 (frame, Tables 1-3)
notModeled: analog inputs and multiplexer (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00); VA is also the reference
conversion is clocked by SCLK (13 SCLK hold/convert); not timed, the result is ready at once

continuous conversion: each further 16 SCLKs in one CS-low frame output another conversion (modeled by repeating the frame pattern); the control word of those later frames is not captured (frame fixed: one command per CS)
SPI mode 3 (CS falls with SCLK high, Figure 1); CS falling with SCLK low is treated by the part as the first falling edge, which a mode-0 host also sees correctly
SCLK frequency limits (8-16 MHz specified); shutdown when CS is high (no visible digital effect)
variants: ADC088S022 and ADC088S052 (separate datasheets): same pinout, control register and frame at other conversion rates
